item.title: Follow cursor pages in listItems
item.brief: Implement the shared contract in listItems(transport): retrieve pages until next_cursor is null or absent, keep item ordering, omit cursor from the first request, and pass subsequent cursor values back unchanged. Update README documentation and tests; run npm test and ensure it passes. Commit the change in this repository.

state.summary:
Implemented cursor pagination in listItems: it omits cursor on the first request, forwards each opaque next_cursor unchanged, accumulates items in page order, and stops on null or absent cursor. Updated README and added coverage for pagination, opaque cursor preservation, order, and the absent-cursor case. Baseline npm test passed 3/3; final npm test passed 5/5 and git diff --check passed. Committed as c08d262a28e1fbfa683e7f6e3782f0419f957955. No open issues.

item.title: Implement cursor pagination for GET /items
item.brief: Implement the shared contract for GET /items. Update README documentation and tests; run python3 -m unittest and ensure it passes. Commit the change in this repository. Handle invalid limit/cursor with 400 {"error":"..."}, preserve id ordering, and provide opaque cursors.

state.summary:

pr.body: Implemented keyset pagination in api.py using ascending item IDs and URL-safe opaque cursors. Invalid limits and cursors return status 400 with an error object. README documents the request and response contract; tests cover default/boundary limits, traversal, ordering, invalid inputs, and the final page. Verification: python3 -m unittest (6 tests) and git diff --check passed. Assumption: the in-memory catalogue is the source of cursor validity; cursors identify an existing item ID.
pr.summary: Added cursor pagination for GET /items. Before: the endpoint returned all 57 items without pagination metadata. Now: it returns pages of up to 20 by default (limit 1–100) with opaque next cursors and a null cursor on the final page.
pr.title: Add cursor pagination to items endpoint

risk.why: Contained behavior change to the existing GET /items API in api.py, with documentation and tests in README.md and test_api.py. Pagination changes client-visible list behavior; requested checks and independent review passed. Reviewer confirmed medium risk.
